subject: KindleWave pilot: procurement gatekeepers, PO format & vendor intake
summary: Post-demo procurement follow-up to map approval owners, confirm vendor intake requirements, PO/invoice remit details, and align on pilot start window. External procurement provided intake URL and W9; Jasmine requests billing contact, PO timing and any SOC2 evidence needs.
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <akim@kindlewave.com>; Monica Reynolds <m.reynolds@kindlewave.com>
Cc: procurement@kindlewave.com; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: KindleWave pilot: procurement gatekeepers, PO format & vendor intake

Hi Alex / Monica — great demo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + asks so we can keep the pilot on track: 

- Economic buyer: Alex confirmed you own the budget but signoff path runs to CFO (Priya Sinha) — can you confirm if Priya will approve the PO or if Finance can sign on her behalf?
- Security/legal: you mentioned a short intake and SOC2 Type II attestation for vendor onboarding. Please confirm the PDF name we should expect or the portal where we upload artifacts.
- Procurement/PO: What PO format do you prefer (PO number only vs PO + statement of work)? Who is the remit-to for invoices (AP email + billing address)?
- Timeline: we discussed a Jan pilot start. For procurement gating, what is your expected lead time after we submit paperwork?

Next steps I propose: I can send a single zip with the vendor intake + W9 + DPA draft. If you prefer, push the intake link to me and I’ll submit directly. Can Monica (or procurement team) confirm the required artifacts and a target PO issuance date?

Attachments: vendor intake form / W9 (will send in next email).

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
From: Alex Kim <akim@kindlewave.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Reynolds <m.reynolds@kindlewave.com>; procurement@kindlewave.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KindleWave pilot: procurement gatekeepers, PO format & vendor intake

Thanks Jasmine — good recap. Couple clarifications: 

1) Priya (CFO) signs any commitments > $50k. Pilot authorization should be handled by Procurement + Finance, we usually issue a PO referencing the SOW. I (Alex) will be the economic sponsor but final invoice approval flows through AP.

2) Monica / procurement team — vendor intake and upload portal lives here: https://vendor.kindlevendor/submit (internal). We need: completed intake PDF, W9, overview of data flows, and SOC2 summary (if you have a short attestation).

3) AP remit / invoice: ap@kindlewave.com — please send invoices to ap@kindlewave.com and set the remit-to address to: KindleWave, 120 Harbor Drive, Suite 400, Seattle, WA 98101.

4) Lead time: once you submit the intake + W9 + SOW, procurement says ~10 business days to get a standard PO in place assuming no redlines. If there are contract redlines, add 7–14 days.

If you want me to expedite with Priya, I can loop her in after you submit the paperwork.

Best — Alex
Alex Kim | Head of Product Partnerships
KindleWave
akim@kindlewave.com
From: procurement@kindlewave.com

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: KindleWave vendor intake: next steps and attachments required

Hi Jasmine / Ben — thanks for the recap. Please complete and upload the following to our portal (link below):

- KindleWave Vendor Intake Form (attached as PDF)
- Signed W9 (attached)
- Short data flow diagram / description (1 page)
- SOC2 Type II report or a brief attestation if the report is under NDA

Portal: https://vendor.kindlevendor/submit
Accepted attachments: PDF, DOCX. File size limit: 20MB.

We received many vendor packets before year-end; to target a PO by 2027-01-10 please submit all artifacts by 2026-12-10.

Attachments: KindleWave_vendor_intake_form.pdf, W9_KindleWave.pdf

Procurement Team
KindleWave — vendor@kindlewave.com
